seoTitle: When Is Black Friday 2026 UK? Dates for Every Retailer
title: When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK? Dates for Amazon, Argos, Currys, Boots and more
description: Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Here's when each big UK retailer's sale is expected to start.
intro:
**Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, and Cyber Monday is on Monday 30 November.** In practice, most UK retailers start their Black Friday sales well before that. Some begin in early November, and Amazon usually runs a Black Friday Week of about 12 days.

This page tracks each retailer's dates. We update it as they announce. Last checked: 26 October 2026, when no major UK retailer had yet confirmed its 2026 dates.
body:
## Black Friday 2026 UK: the key dates

- **Black Friday:** Friday 27 November 2026
- **Cyber Monday:** Monday 30 November 2026
- **Amazon Black Friday Week (predicted):** around 19 or 20 November to 30 November
- **Earliest retailer sales (predicted):** first week of November

## When each retailer's Black Friday sale is expected to start

Nothing below is confirmed for 2026 yet. Each line shows what the retailer did last time, so you know when to start watching.

- **Amazon:** In 2025, Black Friday Week ran from **20 November to 1 December**, and Amazon announced it on 13 November. Its last three announcements came on 2, 8 and 13 November, so expect the 2026 dates in the first half of November. See our [Amazon Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) on timing a trial so you get Prime-only prices.
- **Argos:** Started its Black Friday event on **1 November** in 2024, with new deals every week through November. Expect a similar early start.
- **Currys:** Its Black Friday sale is **already live (from 28 October 2026)**, with a price guarantee: buy by 24 November and if Currys cuts the price before 1 December, it refunds the difference.
- **Boots:** Expected to start in the **first week of November**. Boots also runs weekly Star Gifts alongside its Black Friday offers.
- **Very:** Expected to start in the **first week of November**.
- **Superdrug:** Expected in the **first week of November**. In 2025, members got early access.
- **Ninja and Shark:** Their own websites are expected to start in the **first week of November**. Amazon and Argos usually match their prices.
- **M&S:** Usually one of the latest to start. It was expected to begin on Black Friday itself in 2025.

## Do the best deals come early or on the day?

For most products, the lowest prices land in the **last week before Black Friday**, when Amazon's Black Friday Week starts and the other big retailers match it. Early November deals are often genuine, but they're rarely the lowest prices of the season. Two exceptions: **advent calendars** and **toys** sell out, so buy them early.

Brand by brand, our guides show which prices to wait for: [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/), [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) and more on our [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).

### What date is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November 2026. It's always the Friday after the American Thanksgiving holiday.

### When is Cyber Monday 2026?

Monday 30 November 2026. Many Black Friday deals carry on until then, and some retailers add extra online offers.

### When do Amazon Black Friday deals start in 2026?

Amazon hasn't announced it yet. Based on recent years, expect Black Friday Week to start around 19 or 20 November and run to Cyber Monday, with the announcement in early to mid November.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday?

For tech, vacuums, kitchen gadgets and Amazon devices, usually yes. For things that sell out, like advent calendars, popular toys and limited gift sets, buy when you see a good price.

### Are Black Friday deals real?

Some are, and many aren't. Consumer group Which? has repeatedly found that most Black Friday 'deals' were the same price or cheaper at other times. Our [Black Friday guide](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) explains how to check a price in 30 seconds.
